Supplement to the Proxy Statement

This supplement to the proxy statement dated April 1, 2026 amends and supplements the definitive proxy statement filed with the SEC on April 1, 2026.

Except as described in this supplement, no other changes have been made to the proxy statement.

Supplement to the Proxy Statement for the Annual Meeting

This supplement references the definitive proxy statement filed with the SEC on March 10, 2026.

The proxy statement is hereby supplemented with additional disclosure about Proposal 2.

Supplement to Proxy Statement

The annual meeting date has changed and the annual meeting will now be held on June 15, 2026.

The virtual meeting location has been updated to https://meeting.example.com.

Notice of Annual Meeting

Proposal 1 Election of Directors

Proposal 2 Ratification of Appointment of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm

Proposal 4: Approval of Amendment to Certificate of Incorporation.

Supplement to Proxy Statement

Proposal 2: Ratification of Appointment of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm.

The Board previously recommended a vote FOR Proposal 2.

The Board now recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST Proposal 2.

Supplement to Proxy Statement

Stockholder Proposal: Special Meeting Rights.

The stockholder proposal regarding special meeting rights has been withdrawn and will not be presented at the annual meeting.

The proponent recommends a vote FOR the shareholder proposal.

The Board recommends a vote AGAINST this shareholder proposal.

Proxy Statement/Prospectus Supplement

This supplement to the proxy statement/prospectus updates disclosure about the merger agreement.

The merger litigation has been settled and the parties entered into a settlement agreement.

Proxy Statement/Prospectus Supplement

This supplement to the proxy statement/prospectus updates the merger disclosure.

The fairness opinion was updated and supplemented after the special committee approved updated disclosure.
